name: rarc
description: Remittance Advice Remark Codes (RARC) used in 835 LQ/STC segments. Curated common subset.
source: X12 / Washington Publishing Company Remittance Advice Remark Codes (public)

codes.M15: Separately billed services/tests have been bundled as they are considered components of the same procedure.
codes.M80: Not covered when performed during the same session/date as a previously processed service.
codes.M86: Service denied because payment already made for same/similar procedure within set time frame.
codes.MA01: Alert: If you do not agree with what we approved for these services, you may appeal.
codes.MA15: Alert: Your claim has been separated to expedite handling.
codes.MA130: Your claim contains incomplete and/or invalid information; no appeal rights afforded.
codes.N1: Alert: You may appeal this decision in writing within the established time limit.
codes.N130: Consult plan benefit documents/guidelines for information about restrictions for this service.
codes.N210: Alert: You may appeal this decision.
codes.N370: Billing exceeds the rental months covered/approved by the payer.
codes.N522: Duplicate of a claim processed, or to be processed, as a crossover claim.
codes.N657: This should be billed with the appropriate code for these services.
